title: Systems Simulation & Balance Workbench
objective: Provide deterministic/stochastic batch simulation for game-system parameters, resource flows, economies, encounters and cross-system scenarios using owner-domain rules. Support parameter sweeps, seeded Monte Carlo runs, sensitivity comparisons, target envelopes, regression baselines and exportable evidence. The workbench recommends/proves; it does not silently rebalance canonical rules.

scope.purpose: Provide deterministic and seeded stochastic simulation/balance evidence over owner-domain rules without becoming canonical gameplay/economy/combat authority or silently changing tuned values.
scope.completion_gate: Representative owner-domain rules and parameter projections can be evaluated through deterministic/seeded stochastic simulations with inspectable inputs, seeds, comparisons, target/regression evidence and exports while recommendations remain non-authoritative and invalid rule/parameter/reference states fail closed.

selection_boundaries: Owner Continue on 2026-09-16 governed-started PCA-12; implementation authority is limited to work/pca-12-systems-simulation-balance-workbench.
PCA-01..11 remain completed foundations and must be composed rather than reimplemented or weakened.

PCA-02 retains deterministic/repeatable graph, variant, budget, cache and provenance planning authority; PCA-12 may reuse its deterministic planning patterns but does not turn PCA-02 into gameplay-rule authority.

MIB-13 retains economy/value/market/settlement authority. PCA-12 may consume explicit economy projections and evidence but may not mutate balances, prices, markets, settlement state or economy owner truth.
A7 retains authoritative combat-encounter lifecycle/state/version authority. PCA-12 may consume encounter projections and evidence but may not create or transition authoritative encounters.

Other gameplay/content systems enter PCA-12 only through explicit owner-rule/parameter projections with stable owner authority references; PCA-12 creates no parallel canonical rule ledger and does not infer missing rules.

Seeded stochastic behavior must be reproducible and inspectable. Parameter sweeps, Monte Carlo runs, sensitivity comparisons, target envelopes and regression baselines are advisory evidence only and cannot silently change canonical parameters.

Simulation execution is local deterministic/seeded computation over supplied projections only. No provider/network execution, paid-service activation, public upload, publication, release or canonical mutation is authorized.
PCA-13+, MCS, MCCS, MSAS, SMB-08 and downstream work remain unauthorized.
next_action: Create the focused PCA-12 acceptance and validation profile only, establish causal exact-head RED, then implement the minimum deterministic/seeded stochastic simulation and balance-evidence workbench preserving PCA-02, MIB-13, A7 and generic owner-domain authority.
